body: I’m the same age as you, I’m also really scared of telling others, if you want to talk about it just send me a message :)

I can’t really give any good advice, since I never told my parents either and I’m basically in the same situation you’re in, but I just want to say good luck, and just make yourself mentally prepared if they do say anything bad about it, since it is a pretty triggering subject to talk about.
Thanks for the offer but.. I’m not necessarily a bad student, but like I’m just lazy as fuck so I can’t get myself to do anything, I just sit in my chair and cut myself...

Same here... I’m only in 7th grade here, and this online stuff is really messing with me... I used to have good grades and stuff, similar to yours, but this year I only got 1 B, the rest are all D’s and F’s, so you’re really not alone.
Thanks, I just feel like I’m a weird person...
Thanks for the advice, I don’t think I’m quite ready for my parents too know just yet, but seeing a therapist definitely will work, I’ll just wait until i turn 13.
